The '''Scurrg H-6 Bomber''' was an experimental [[Bomber/Legends|bomber]].

==History==
[[File:GS-100.jpg|thumb|left|180px|Two Scurrg H-6 bombers attacking a GS-100 salvage ship]]
The Scurrg H-6 was created five years before the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]] by the [[Nubia Star Drives, Incorporated/Legends|Nubian Design Collective]], who hoped to sell the design to the [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]]. However, the Naboo had no need for such a bomber, and the original prototype was stolen by the [[Feeorin/Legends|Feeorin]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Nym/Legends|Nym]], who later named it [[Havoc (starfighter)|''Havoc'']]. Several other prototypes were produced with only minor improvements, but the price tag on the starfighter dissuaded a number of potential buyers from investing in it.<ref name="TCWCG" />
